Name: Spooky Halloween Inspired Ranch
Author: sakialyn
Description:
It's Spooky Time once again, and that means more spooky additions! This time bringing you some spooky additions to your Barns and Coops!

[b]Zombie Pigs[/b] - Freshly returned from the grave! They're eager to dig up all sorts of things from the graveyard for you.

[b]Mummied Sheep[/b] - Who needs a loom when you got sheep you can pull the cloth right off of? Just make sure to wash it first before general use.

[b]WereCows[/b] - Some cows moo, but these ones howl. Harvested milk can be turned into cheese with a strong enough taste to put hair on your chest... And probably some other places too.

[b]Dracuclucks[/b] - Need a bit more iron in your diet? These chickens provide eggs packed to the brim! Just be careful the flock doesn't come for your blood.

Recipes can be bought from Gus!

Happy Halloween!

Pairs well with JazzMinK's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4266]Halloween Feelings[/url] map mod for a more spooky playtime!

Downloads.Description: Fixed an error with one of the recipes.
